source.author: ov
source.text: Quin etiam mansura dabo monimenta per aevum, inque domo soceri semper spectabere nostri, ut mea se sponsi soletur imagine coniunx?
source.text_original: Quin etiam mansura dabo monimenta per aevum, / inque domo soceri semper spectabere nostri, / ut mea se sponsi soletur imagine coniunx?'
source.text_english: Nay, I will even give lasting memorials through the ages, and in the house of my father-in-law you will always be gazed upon, so that my wife may be comforted by the image of her husband as she is wont to be.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: hic soror Aeoliden aevum mansura per omne deserit, heu saevae nequiquam erepta novercae.
reuse.text_original: hic soror Aeoliden aevum mansura per omne / deserit, heu saevae nequiquam erepta novercae.
reuse.text_english: Here the sister leaves the Aeolid, to remain through all time, alas, snatched in vain from her cruel stepmother.
